findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name HTTP requests in tqdm contrib integrations
 * @description Finds uses of the requests library in tqdm.contrib modules (slack, telegram, discord) for further manual review.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/tqdm-requests-usage
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-200
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request", "Session"]).getACall()
select call, "HTTP request made via requests in tqdm.contrib. Ensure URLs and headers are not influenced by untrusted input without validation."
findings.hypothesis: tqdm contrib modules for slack/telegram/discord may make HTTP requests that could expose sensitive data or be SSRF vectors if URLs are user-controlled.
